design: A small universal evidence core is combined with zero or more research-type extensions selected by the approved protocol.

backward_compatibility.1.x: Existing projects retain the legacy quantitative-leaning evidence columns and are validated without migration.
backward_compatibility.2.x: New projects use the case-neutral universal evidence core and composable research-type extensions.
backward_compatibility.migration: No automatic migration is performed. A future explicit migration must preserve original rows and create a reviewable mapping log.

composition_rule: A protocol may select any compatible combination of research types. Each evidence row declares its applicable research_types as a JSON array. Required extension fields are enforced only when their declared research_types intersect the row types; selecting a type does not make every catalog field mandatory for unrelated rows.

extension_field_contract.storage: Each CSV row stores a JSON object in extension_json. It is validated against 00_protocol/DOMAIN_EXTENSION_SCHEMA.json.

evidence_locator_contract.rule: Every substantive record must use source-appropriate exact locators. Full-text records require a page, section, figure, or table; documentary or material records may additionally use archive, catalogue, or object references.
